newsitem.title: CHINA: Kumagai (HK) ends Asean Resources talks.
newsitem.headline: Kumagai (HK) ends Asean Resources talks.

text.p: Kumagai Gumi (Hong Kong) Ltd said on Monday it had terminted talks regarding the possible purchase of assets from Asean Resources Holdings Ltd.

"The company had prior to this announcement been negotiating with Asean Resources Holdings Ltd in connection with a possible acquisition of certain assets of Asean by the company but such negotiation has been terminated," it said.
"There are no negotiation or agreements with any other party as speculated," it said.
Trading in the company's shares resumed on Monday, falling HK$0.65 to HK$8.45 in early trade.
Asean Resources is a property investment and management company. It also manufactures leather goods.
